context: Tests that Step 4 uses Experience Catalyst directly when a source URL is present and the design skill is available. WebFetch failure must not cause a palette question, DesignSync routing, or manual rebrand fallback.

checklist.name: Uses Catalyst design skill
checklist.description: The agent invokes or explicitly hands off to excat-complete-design-expert in Complete Migration mode.

checklist.name: Passes source URL
checklist.description: The handoff includes the provided source URL as the source for design extraction.

checklist.name: Does not ask for palette
checklist.description: The agent does not ask the user to provide colors, a palette, or choose how to source the look.

check.value: how should I source|give (me|you) the colors|provide .*colors|provide .*palette|user-supplied palette

checklist.name: Does not treat WebFetch as blocker
checklist.description: The agent does not present WebFetch failure as a reason to stop or ask for manual brand inputs.

checklist.name: Does not route to DesignSync
checklist.description: The agent does not route the work to DesignSync or a generic design-project tool.

checklist.name: No manual rebrand fallback
checklist.description: The agent does not hand-edit styles.css or claim manual CSS edits as a substitute for Catalyst.
